subject: SolidGeometry
question:
A cube is rolled on a plane around its edges. Its bottom face passes through positions $1,2,3,4,5,6$ and 7 in that order, as shown. Which two of these positions were occupied by the same face of the cube? <image1>
Choices:
A:1 and 7
B:1 and 6
C:1 and 5
D:2 and 7
E:2 and 6
original_question: A cube is being rolled on a plane so it turns around its edges. Its bottom face passes through the positions $1,2,3,4,5,6$ and 7 in that order, as shown. Which of these two positions were occupied by the same face of the cube? <image1>
